topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I can't believe this. Just when I thought everything was settled, just when I dared to think I was finally in my new home, I stumble upon this. A hidden room, tucked away as if it were a secret worth keeping. What were they thinking, the builders, the sellers, to hide something like this? What have I actually bought? I don't need surprises, especially not ones locked away, forgotten. This isn't what I agreed to. There's a lot of explaining that needs to happen, and I intend to find out every last detail about this so-called 'hidden gem.' It feels like a betrayal, a mockery of what should have been a fresh start. Well, they'll hear from me, and soon.
